# Settings

The options the product adds to Settings, with their meaning.

| Setting | Type | Meaning | Module |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Accounting Deployment** (`rebuild_einvoice_environment`) | selection | Live activation is allowed only on the deployed production system. | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Approved Platform** (`rebuild_einvoice_provider`) | selection | The default French adapter uses Odoo's hosted Approved Platform service. No connection is made until production activation. | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Full Activation Checklist** (`rebuild_einvoice_blockers`) | text |  | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Live Reception** (`rebuild_einvoice_connection_status`) | selection |  | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Production Activation Approved** (`rebuild_einvoice_activation_approved`) | boolean |  | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Production Onboarding** (`rebuild_einvoice_provider_contract_status`) | selection | Derived from Odoo's production identity verification. Demo and test identities never count as production onboarding. | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Reception Validation** (`rebuild_einvoice_capability_status`) | selection |  | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Shareholder / Expense Owner** (`rebuild_overview_cca_employee_id`) | many2one | Employee whose unpaid employee-paid expenses are included in the shareholder current-account projection. | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Shareholder Current Account** (`rebuild_overview_cca_account_id`) | many2one | Account 455 used by the Accounting Overview to estimate the position with one shareholder. The delivered USL configuration uses 455100. | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Status** (`rebuild_einvoice_readiness_status`) | selection |  | `rebuild_account_migration` |
| **Late-payment penalty wording** (`usl_invoice_late_penalty_text`) | char | Rate or calculation rule printed on French customer invoices. | `usl_accounting` |
| **Payment-rate maximum delay** (`immediate_settlement_max_days`) | integer | Maximum calendar-day gap for treating a foreign-currency document and its bank transaction as one immediate economic event. Exact foreign-amount settlement remains available outside this delay. | `usl_accounting` |
| **Payment-rate maximum rate deviation (%)** (`immediate_settlement_max_rate_deviation`) | float | Maximum deviation between the bank's inferred executed rate and Odoo's reference rate for the Use payment rate action. | `usl_accounting` |
| **Recovery fee** (`usl_invoice_recovery_fee`) | monetary | Fixed indemnity for recovery costs printed on French business invoices. | `usl_accounting` |
| **Allow communication with historical B2C customers** (`allow_historical_b2c_customer_communication`) | boolean | Allow customer-facing messages from reconstructed historical Sales orders. Invoice creation remains blocked because their Accounting history was restored separately. | `usl_b2c` |
| **Last successful synchronization** (`paperless_last_sync`) | char |  | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless Health** (`paperless_health`) | char |  | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless integration token** (`paperless_token`) | char |  | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless internal URL** (`paperless_url`) | char | Container-network URL used only by the Odoo server. | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless public URL** (`paperless_public_url`) | char | Secured user-facing URL used for Open in Paperless. | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless service user ID** (`paperless_service_user_id`) | integer | Dedicated non-human Paperless owner used by server-side integration. | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless streaming timeout** (`paperless_stream_timeout`) | integer | Maximum server-to-server read time for one streamed binary request. | `usl_documents` |
| **Paperless timeout** (`paperless_timeout`) | integer |  | `usl_documents` |
| **Enable the feedback assistant** (`feedback_agent_enabled`) | boolean |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Feedback Connection Checked At** (`feedback_connection_checked_at`) | datetime |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Feedback Connection Detail** (`feedback_connection_detail`) | char |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Feedback Connection Status** (`feedback_connection_status`) | selection | Values: **Not tested**, **Ready**, **Failed**. | `usl_feedback` |
| **Feedback Has Gemini Api Key** (`feedback_has_gemini_api_key`) | boolean |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Feedback Has Mcp Api Key** (`feedback_has_mcp_api_key`) | boolean |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Gemini model** (`feedback_gemini_model`) | selection | Values: **Gemini 3.7 Flash**, **Gemini 3.6 Flash**. | `usl_feedback` |
| **New Gemini API key** (`feedback_gemini_api_key_input`) | char |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **New Odoo API key** (`feedback_mcp_api_key_input`) | char |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Paid tier and seven-day retention confirmed** (`feedback_paid_tier_confirmed`) | boolean |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Projects MCP URL** (`feedback_mcp_url`) | char |  | `usl_feedback` |
| **Daily Bitcoin existence proof** (`sign_opentimestamps_enabled`) | boolean | Submit each closed UTC day's signed evidence manifest to OpenTimestamps. Confirmation is asynchronous and never delays a signature request's completion. | `usl_sign` |
| **Default signing policy** (`sign_default_policy_id`) | many2one |  | `usl_sign` |
| **Use independent RFC 3161 timestamping** (`sign_rfc3161_enabled`) | boolean |  | `usl_sign` |
